description: Jellyfin Enhanced coexistence in the experimental layout: viewer with accessroles-je-probe.mjs's lock-only role (Profile, Quick Connect, Jellyfin Enhanced locked) next to Jellyfin Enhanced 12.14, in the experimental layout (localStorage 'layout' = 'experimental' before the bundles run). JE's cloned entry in the MUI user menu (#jellyfinEnhancedUserMenuLink, its href '#') is in the menu and hidden with EnhancedPanel, Profile too, Settings shown, the menu's top divider not left alone; JE's D key ends on Home (the core's bounce) and its Q key on Home with the guard's toast, each address recorded before any page script.

steps.name: the experimental layout
a recorder of the page's addresses and of visible Quick Connect frames, before any page script
steps.initScript: (() => { const R = window.__jfarJe = { hashes: [], frames: {}, toasts: [] }; const note = () => { const h = location.hash; if (R.hashes[R.hashes.length - 1] !== h) R.hashes.push(h); }; window.addEventListener('hashchange', note, true); window.addEventListener('popstate', note, true); const tick = () => { try { note(); document.querySelectorAll('.jfar-toast').forEach((t) => { const x = t.textContent; if (x && !R.toasts.includes(x)) R.toasts.push(x); }); document.querySelectorAll('#quickConnectPreferencesPage').forEach((p) => { if (!p.classList.contains('hide') && p.getClientRects().length > 0 && getComputedStyle(p).visibility !== 'hidden') { R.frames[p.id] = (R.frames[p.id] || 0) + 1; } }); } catch (e) { } requestAnimationFrame(tick); }; requestAnimationFrame(tick); })()

steps.name: sign in as viewer
the guard has viewer's /Me with the three locks, the MUI app bar is up
JE loaded with its key listener and its shortcuts
JE has had its time to clone its entry
open the user menu
JE's cloned entry is in the menu
the menu: its items and dividers, shown or hidden
steps.eval: (() => { const m = document.getElementById('app-user-menu'); const list = m.querySelector('ul'); const shown = (e) => getComputedStyle(e).display !== 'none' && e.getClientRects().length > 0; const children = [...list.children].map((c) => ({ tag: c.tagName, id: c.id || null, href: c.getAttribute('href'), text: c.textContent.trim(), shown: shown(c), aria: c.getAttribute('aria-disabled') })); const visible = children.filter((c) => c.shown); return { children, firstVisible: visible.length ? visible[0].tag : null }; })()

steps.name: JE's entry and Profile hidden (aria-disabled), Settings shown, no divider left at the top
steps.assert: (() => { const je = __vars.menu.children.find((c) => c.id === 'jellyfinEnhancedUserMenuLink'); const p = __vars.menu.children.find((c) => (c.href || '').indexOf('#/userprofile') === 0); const s = __vars.menu.children.find((c) => c.href === '#/mypreferencesmenu'); return !!je && !je.shown && !!p && !p.shown && p.aria === 'true' && !!s && s.shown && __vars.menu.firstVisible !== 'HR'; })()

steps.name: close the menu
nothing focused, the recorder reset
steps.script: if (document.activeElement && document.activeElement !== document.body) document.activeElement.blur(); window.__jfarJe.hashes = [location.hash]; window.__jfarJe.frames = {}; window.__jfarJe.toasts = []; return location.hash;

steps.name: press D
where D went
steps.eval: ({ hashes: window.__jfarJe.hashes.slice(), now: location.hash, toasts: window.__jfarJe.toasts.slice() })

steps.name: D took the page to the Dashboard's address, and it ended on Home
nothing focused, the recorder reset again
steps.script: if (document.activeElement && document.activeElement !== document.body) document.activeElement.blur(); window.__jfarJe.hashes = [location.hash]; window.__jfarJe.frames = {}; window.__jfarJe.toasts = []; document.querySelectorAll('.jfar-toast').forEach((t) => t.remove()); return location.hash;

steps.name: press Q
where Q went
steps.eval: ({ hashes: window.__jfarJe.hashes.slice(), now: location.hash, frames: Object.assign({}, window.__jfarJe.frames), toasts: window.__jfarJe.toasts.slice() })

steps.name: Q took the page to Quick Connect's address, and it ended on Home with the guard's toast, Quick Connect never shown
steps.assert: __vars.q.hashes.some((h) => /^#\/quickconnect/i.test(h)) && __vars.q.now.startsWith('#/home') && Object.keys(__vars.q.frames).length === 0 && __vars.q.toasts.includes('This page is managed by your server administrator.')

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag and jellyfin-web's Home tab slider excepted)
